description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Sharuum.
Sharuum enters the battlefield, returning Su-Chi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
